schema.reason: Full benchmark schemas, keys and constraints exceed the two-column published Table profile.

transactions.reason: No declarative multi-statement transaction session; separate resources have no implicit atomic commit.

relational.reason: No joins, grouping, sorting or general subqueries; each finite plan reads one source.

expressions.reason: No decimal/date arithmetic, general expressions or compound predicates.

bulk.reason: No declarative COPY or query-driven INSERT/DELETE; literal inserts have at most three rows.

suite_driver.reason: Standard generators, scales, mixes, concurrency, timing rules and complete workload oracles are not implemented.

SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM stock
CREATE TABLE stock (id INT64 NOT NULL, quantity INT64 NULL)

UPDATE stock SET quantity = 42 WHERE id = 1
DELETE FROM stock WHERE id = 2

CREATE TABLE lineitem (id INT64 NOT NULL, quantity INT64 NULL)
